description.p1: I'm a Master's student in Data Science & Engineering (SID) in Toulouse, working as a data scientist apprentice at Dalkia since August 2026. I handle anything data and AI there: heat substation modeling, task automation, dashboards and AI training for internal teams.
description.p2: What I enjoy most is shipping a complete tool, not just a model in a notebook. On my side project Variant, I build everything: the Python pipelines, the vision model that recognizes cards, the API and the mobile and web apps.
description.p3: Longer term, I'd like to work in AI abroad, ideally in China.
